LAW AND MOTION 301, PLAINTIFFS DONALD CARMIGNANI, AND MICHAEL CARMIGNANI'S MOTION TO STRIKE OR TAX COSTS IS GRANTED IN PART. THE COST CLAIMED BY THE WIVES ARE STRICKEN WITH THE EXCEPTION OF THE $1,520.70 OF COST INCURRED POST REMAND. THE COURT INDICATED THERE IS A UNITY OF INTEREST WHICH IS AN EXCEPTION TO WHAT WOULD OTHERWISE BE A MANDATORY COST AWARD LEAVING THE COURT WITH DISCRETION TO AWARD, DENY OR ALLOCATE COST TO THESE DEFENDANTS WHO ULTIMATELY OBTAINED THE DISMISSAL WITHOUT ANY JUDGMENT BEING ENTERED AGAINST THEM. IT IS FAIR TO ALLOCATE IN THIS WAY TO THIS LIMITED PORTION OF THE CASE WHERE THEY WERE REQUIRED TO CONTINUE TO DEFEND THEMSELVES AS DEFENDANT ON THIER OWN AFTER PLAINTIFF HAD ALREADY OBTAINED FULL RECOVERY.
